entries.positive_observation: The bald front crown and high receding hairline retain very short grey hair at the sides/back, narrow grey sideburns, thin grey brows and fine round-to-octagonal wire spectacles. The face has no moustache or beard and one serious closed mouth, with a nearly frontal direct-gaze pose and original crop. The dark olive uniform retains gold shoulder cords, densely gold-embroidered red standing-collar patches, a narrow pale shirt edge, one large silver-white star-shaped throat cross and one gold eagle-shaped breast badge on image left. The rounded chin meets a short broad fitted neckline without a stalk or pinching. The continuous cream/beige/light-grey painted backplate fills the original rectangle through every corner, with its mottling and vignette retained and no programmatic replacement backdrop. Derived full and sheet viewing confirms unchanged RGB with no visible matte, halo, holes or backing loss.
